audio.t: What did the man forget for art class?
Have you got your paints for art, Tom?
Yes, and my brushes too. But I forgot my pencil case at home.

items.q: What did the man forget for art class?
items.vi: Người đàn ông có màu và cọ nhưng 'forgot my pencil case' (quên hộp bút chì), nên đáp án là cây bút chì.

audio.t: What does the man like best at school?
Do you like math, Ben?
It's OK, but music is better. Today we play the guitar in class.

items.q: What does the man like best at school?
items.vi: Anh ấy nói 'music is better' (âm nhạc hay hơn) và hôm nay chơi guitar, nên chọn đàn guitar.

audio.t: What time does school start today?
Does school start at eight o'clock today?
No, not today. There is a teachers' meeting, so we start at nine.

items.q: What time does school start today?
items.vi: Có họp giáo viên nên 'we start at nine' (chín giờ bắt đầu), không phải tám giờ.

audio.t: What is the homework?
Your homework is to read the story on page ten.
Do we have to write about it?
Not this time. Just read it.

items.q: What is the homework?
items.vi: Cô giáo nói chỉ cần đọc truyện ('Just read it'), không phải viết, nên chọn quyển sách.

audio.t: Who is coming to get the boy after school?
Is your dad coming to get you after school?
No, he works late today. My grandmother is coming instead.

items.q: Who is coming to get the boy after school?
items.vi: Bố làm việc muộn, nên 'my grandmother is coming' (bà sẽ đến đón).

audio.t: How much does the woman pay for her own ticket?
Two tickets for the school play, please. One for me and one for my mother.
Students pay six dollars, and adults pay ten dollars.

items.q: How much does the woman pay for her own ticket?
items.vi: Cô ấy là học sinh nên trả 6 đô la ('Students pay six dollars'); mẹ cô là người lớn trả 10 đô la.

audio.t: Where is the library?
Excuse me, where is the library?
Go past the gym. It's next to the computer room, on the second floor. The office is downstairs.

items.q: Where is the library?
items.vi: Thư viện 'next to the computer room' (cạnh phòng máy tính) ở tầng hai; phòng hành chính ở tầng dưới.

audio.t: When is the science test?
Is the English test on Tuesday?
No, that's the math test. English is on Thursday, and science is on Friday.

items.q: When is the science test?
items.vi: 'Science is on Friday' (khoa học vào thứ Sáu). Thứ Ba là toán, thứ Năm là tiếng Anh.

audio.t: What time does the reading club finish?
Does the reading club finish at five o'clock?
No, it begins at three and finishes at half past four.

items.q: What time does the reading club finish?
items.vi: Câu lạc bộ đọc sách bắt đầu lúc ba giờ và kết thúc 'half past four' (bốn giờ rưỡi).

audio.t: Which room is the music lesson in?
Is music in Room twelve?
No, that has changed. It's in Room twenty-one now. Room fifteen is for art.

items.q: Which room is the music lesson in?
items.vi: Giờ nhạc đã đổi sang 'Room twenty-one' (phòng 21). Phòng 15 là cho môn mỹ thuật.

parts.instr: Listen to Mia and Leo talking about a school project. For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Nghe Mia và Leo nói về một dự án ở trường. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: Hi, Leo. Are you ready for our science project?
Hi, Mia. Yes, I brought a book about the moon.
Great. Our teacher, Mrs. Green, says we must make a big poster and give a short talk.
When do we have to give the talk?
Next Wednesday, in the first lesson.
Oh, that's only six days away! We should start today.
I agree. Can you come to my house after school?
Not today. I have a piano lesson at four. How about tomorrow?
Tomorrow is fine. My brother can help us with the computer.
Good idea. What shall we put on the poster?
I think some pictures of the moon and a few facts.
I can draw the pictures. I'm good at drawing.
Then I'll write the facts. Don't forget to bring colored pens.
I won't. Should we make a model of the moon too?
No, that takes too long. The poster is enough.

items.q: When must they give the talk?
items.vi: Mia nói 'Next Wednesday, in the first lesson' (thứ Tư tuần sau, tiết đầu tiên).

items.q: Why can't Leo work on the project today?
options: He has to go to the dentist.
items.vi: Leo nói 'I have a piano lesson at four' (bốn giờ cậu có buổi học piano).

items.q: Who will help with the computer?
items.vi: Mia nói 'My brother can help us with the computer' (anh trai Mia sẽ giúp dùng máy tính).

items.q: What will Leo do for the poster?
items.vi: Leo nói 'I can draw the pictures' (mình vẽ tranh); Mia sẽ viết thông tin.

items.q: Where will they meet tomorrow?
items.vi: Mia mời Leo đến nhà mình ('come to my house') và hẹn ngày mai, nên họ gặp ở nhà Mia.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: What must students bring to school tomorrow?

items.q: What must students bring to school tomorrow?

items.q: What time does the school concert start?
items.vi: Cửa mở lúc sáu giờ rưỡi nhưng 'the concert starts at seven' (buổi hòa nhạc bắt đầu lúc bảy giờ).

audio.t: Why will Sam wait at home?
Hi Sam, it's Miss Lopez. Your mother called about the school bus. It will be late this morning, so please wait at home until eight. Don't walk to school because of the rain.

items.q: Why will Sam wait at home?
items.vi: Cô Lopez nói xe buýt trường sẽ đến muộn ('It will be late'), nên Sam chờ ở nhà.

audio.t: Which tour is the last one?

Welcome to our school open day. There are three tours today. The first one is at ten, for parents of new students. The second, at eleven, is for the science rooms. The last tour is at noon, in the school garden.

items.q: Which tour is the last one?
items.vi: 'The last tour is at noon, in the school garden' (tour cuối vào buổi trưa, ở vườn trường).

audio.t: Until what time can students collect their things?
Attention, please. A blue jacket, a red water bottle and a pair of glasses were found in the playground. You can collect them from the office before four o'clock.

items.q: Until what time can students collect their things?
items.vi: Học sinh có thể lấy đồ ở văn phòng 'before four o'clock' (trước bốn giờ).

items.text: Mrs. Wood's class: Please bring a pencil and an eraser to the math test on Friday. Calculators are not allowed.
items.q: What does it say?
options: The math test is on Monday.
Students must bring a pencil and an eraser.
Students can use calculators in the test.
items.vi: Thông báo yêu cầu mang bút chì và cục tẩy; máy tính không được dùng, bài kiểm tra vào thứ Sáu.

items.text: Library: Books must be returned after two weeks. You can borrow up to three books at one time.
items.q: What does it say?
options: The library is closed for two weeks.
Students can keep a book for two weeks.
Students can borrow as many books as they like.

items.text: Hi Nina, I can't come to homework club today because my bus is late. Can you tell Mr. Fox? Thanks, Ella
items.q: What does Ella want Nina to do?
options: Tell Mr. Fox she can't come
items.vi: Ella nhờ Nina báo với thầy Fox rằng bạn ấy không đến được câu lạc bộ làm bài tập.

items.text: Please do not run in the corridors. Walk on the left.
items.q: What does it say?
options: Students can run on the left.
Students must walk, not run, in the corridors.
items.vi: Biển báo: không chạy trong hành lang, hãy đi bộ bên trái.

items.text: Dear parents, the school trip to the science museum is now on Thursday, not Wednesday. Please send the permission form by Monday. Mr. Hill
items.q: What must parents do?
items.vi: Phụ huynh phải gửi đơn cho phép chậm nhất vào thứ Hai ('by Monday').

items.text: New students: Please meet Ms. Reed at the school office at 8:15 on your first day. She will show you your classroom.
items.q: What does it say?
options: Ms. Reed is a new student.
Ms. Reed will show new students their classroom.
New students should go straight to the classroom.
items.vi: Cô Reed sẽ chỉ lớp học cho học sinh mới sau khi gặp ở văn phòng lúc 8:15.

parts.instr: Read about three students and their favorite lessons. For each question, choose Lily, Omar or Zoe.
parts.instrVi: Đọc về ba học sinh và môn học yêu thích của họ. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn Lily, Omar hoặc Zoe.

items.text:
Lily: My favorite lesson is art. Our teacher lets us paint big pictures on the classroom wall. I go to the art club on Tuesdays after school, and I'm learning to make clay bowls. I want to be a designer one day.

Omar: I love science because we do experiments. Last week we made a small volcano, and it was very funny! I'm not good at drawing, but I always get good marks in science. I sit next to my best friend, Ken, and we work together.

Zoe: Music is the best lesson for me. I play the violin in the school orchestra, and we practice every morning before school. I'm a little shy, but I feel happy when we play on stage. My teacher says I should help younger students too.

items.q: Who makes things from clay?
items.vi: Lily 'learning to make clay bowls' (học làm bát đất sét).

items.q: Who works with a best friend in lessons?
items.vi: Omar ngồi cạnh bạn thân Ken và làm việc cùng nhau.

items.q: Who practices before school?
items.vi: Zoe và dàn nhạc tập 'every morning before school' (mỗi sáng trước giờ học).

items.q: Who wants to be a designer?
items.vi: Lily nói 'I want to be a designer one day' (muốn trở thành nhà thiết kế).

items.q: Who feels a little shy?
items.vi: Zoe nói 'I'm a little shy' (hơi nhút nhát).

items.q: Who made a small volcano last week?
items.vi: Omar kể tuần trước họ làm một ngọn núi lửa nhỏ trong giờ khoa học.

items.q: Who goes to a club on Tuesdays?
items.vi: Lily đi câu lạc bộ mỹ thuật vào thứ Ba sau giờ học.

parts.instr: Read the story. For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Đọc câu chuyện. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

items.text:
Daniel was a shy boy in Class 6B. He had good ideas, but he never put his hand up in lessons. When the teacher, Mr. Brown, asked a question, Daniel looked at his desk and waited for someone else to answer.

One Monday, Mr. Brown told the class about a project. 'Every student will give a short talk about a favorite object,' he said. 'It will be on Friday.' Daniel felt sick. He could not sleep that night.

On Tuesday, Daniel's grandfather gave him an old wooden compass. 'It helped me find my way when I was young,' he said. 'Tell your class about it.' Daniel smiled. He practiced his talk every evening in front of the mirror.

On Friday, Daniel's hands were cold, but he stood in front of the class. He held up the compass and told the story of his grandfather. Nobody made a noise. When he finished, everybody clapped, and Mr. Brown said, 'That was the best talk today.'

After the lesson, a girl called Priya came to his desk. 'Can you help me with my talk next time?' she asked. Daniel laughed. 'Of course,' he said.

items.q: What was Daniel like at the start of the story?
items.vi: Truyện mở đầu: 'Daniel was a shy boy' (Daniel là cậu bé nhút nhát).

items.q: What did Mr. Brown ask the students to do?
options: Write a story about a compass
Draw a picture of an old object
Give a short talk about a favorite object
items.vi: Thầy Brown yêu cầu mỗi học sinh nói một bài ngắn về một đồ vật yêu thích.

items.q: Where did the compass come from?
items.vi: Ông của Daniel đã tặng cậu chiếc la bàn gỗ cũ.

items.q: How did Daniel get ready for the talk?
options: He practiced in front of a mirror.
He asked Priya to help him.
items.vi: Daniel 'practiced his talk every evening in front of the mirror' (tập nói mỗi tối trước gương).

items.q: What did Priya want at the end?
items.vi: Priya hỏi 'Can you help me with my talk next time?' (nhờ Daniel giúp bài nói lần sau).

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct word.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn từ đúng.

items.text: Please open your books at ＿ twenty.
items.vi: 'Open your books at page twenty' nghĩa là mở sách ở trang hai mươi.

items.text: I forgot my homework, so the teacher was ＿ with me.
items.vi: Quên bài tập nên cô giáo 'angry' (giận).

items.text: We write on the ＿ with a white marker.
items.vi: Chúng ta viết lên 'board' (bảng) bằng bút lông trắng.

items.text: At the end of the term, we get our school ＿ and show it to our parents.
items.vi: 'School report' là bảng nhận xét kết quả học tập cuối kỳ.

items.text: Can I ＿ your ruler, please? I forgot mine.
items.vi: 'Borrow' là mượn của người khác; 'lend' là cho mượn.

items.text: The test was very ＿, and nobody finished it.
items.vi: Không ai làm xong bài nên bài kiểm tra rất 'difficult' (khó).

parts.instr: Write one word in each gap.
parts.instrVi: Điền một từ vào mỗi chỗ trống.

items.text: My school starts ＿ eight o'clock.
items.vi: Dùng giới từ 'at' trước giờ cụ thể: at eight o'clock.

items.text: Yesterday I ＿ late for the first lesson.
items.vi: 'Yesterday' là quá khứ, chủ ngữ 'I' nên dùng 'was'.

items.text: We have ＿ new computer room this year.
items.vi: Danh từ số ít đếm được 'computer room' cần mạo từ 'a'.

items.text: Mia is taller ＿ her brother.
items.vi: So sánh hơn dùng 'than': taller than.

items.text: Do you want ＿ come to my birthday party?
items.vi: 'Want' đi với 'to + động từ': want to come.

items.text: There ＿ twenty-five students in my class.
items.vi: 'There are' dùng với danh từ số nhiều (twenty-five students).

parts.instr: Read the email from your friend. Write an email to Alex. Write 25 words or more.
parts.instrVi: Đọc email của bạn. Viết email trả lời Alex. Viết từ 25 từ trở lên.

items.q:
Read the email.

Hi! I'm in a new class this year and I like it a lot. What is your class like? Who is your teacher? What do you do at break? Write soon, Alex

Write an email to Alex and answer the questions. Write about: your class, your teacher, what you do at break.
items.sample: Hi Alex, thanks for your email. My class is big and friendly. My teacher is Mr. Lee, and he is very funny. At break I talk with my friends and we eat some fruit in the yard. Write soon! Dan
items.vi: Trả lời ba ý: lớp học của bạn, giáo viên, và việc làm giờ ra chơi. Mở đầu bằng lời cảm ơn và kết thúc bằng lời chào.

parts.instr: Look at the three pictures. Write a story. Write 35 words or more.
parts.instrVi: Nhìn ba bức tranh. Viết một câu chuyện. Viết từ 35 từ trở lên.

items.q: Look at the three pictures and write a story about a morning at school. Write 35 words or more.
items.sample: Last Monday Tom woke up late. He ran to school but the bus was already gone. He arrived at the classroom at nine o'clock. His teacher smiled and said, 'Sit down, Tom. We are on page ten.' He felt happy.
items.vi: Kể theo thứ tự ba tranh: thức dậy muộn, chạy đi, đến trường. Dùng thì quá khứ đơn (woke, ran, arrived).

parts.instr: Answer the questions about yourself.
parts.instrVi: Trả lời các câu hỏi về bản thân.

items.q: What is your name, and how old are you?
items.sample: My name is Linh and I am twelve years old. I live in Hanoi with my family.
items.vi: Giới thiệu tên và tuổi: My name is... and I am ... years old.

items.q: Tell me about your school. What is it like?
items.sample: My school is big and new. It has a nice library and a large yard. I like my teachers.
items.vi: Mô tả trường: lớn hay nhỏ, có gì (thư viện, sân), và bạn thích điều gì.

items.q: What is your favorite lesson, and why?
items.sample: My favorite lesson is English because the teacher is funny and we play games.
items.vi: Nêu môn yêu thích và lý do với 'because'.

items.q: What do you do after school?
items.sample: After school I do my homework and then I help my mother at home. Sometimes I watch TV.
items.vi: Kể các việc bạn làm sau giờ học: làm bài tập, giúp việc nhà, xem TV.

parts.instr: Talk about the pictures.
parts.instrVi: Nói về các bức tranh.

items.q: Look at the picture. Talk about a classroom. What can you see, and what do you do there?
items.sample: I can see a classroom with desks, books and pencils. Students learn here every day. I like reading books in the classroom with my friends because it is quiet and warm.
items.vi: Tả lớp học: có bàn, sách, bút chì; bạn làm gì ở đó và vì sao bạn thích.

items.q: Which lesson do you like best: art, music or science? Say why.
items.sample: I like music best because I love singing with my friends. Art is nice too, but I am not good at drawing. Science is interesting, but the tests are difficult.
items.vi: Chọn một môn, giải thích bằng 'because', và có thể so sánh với hai môn còn lại.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct picture.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn bức tranh đúng.

audio.t: What did the man have for breakfast?
Did you have eggs for breakfast, Tom?
No, I had toast and orange juice.

items.q: What did the man have for breakfast?
items.vi: Người đàn ông nói "I had toast and orange juice" (Tôi ăn bánh mì nướng và uống nước cam), không phải trứng.

audio.t: What is Anna cooking tonight?
Anna, are you making soup tonight?
No, soup is for tomorrow. Tonight I'm making pasta.

items.q: What is Anna cooking tonight?
items.vi: Anna nói "Tonight I'm making pasta" (Tối nay tôi làm mì Ý); súp là cho ngày mai.

audio.t: What does the girl want for dessert?
Would you like cake or ice cream?
I had ice cream yesterday. Cake, please.

items.q: What does the girl want for dessert?
items.vi: Cô bé đã ăn kem hôm qua nên chọn bánh ngọt: "Cake, please".

audio.t: Which fruit did the boy buy?
Did you buy bananas, Sam?
No, they were too expensive. I bought grapes. The apples looked old.

items.q: Which fruit did the boy buy?
items.vi: Cậu bé nói mua nho (grapes); táo trông cũ, chuối thì không mua.

audio.t: What will they take to the picnic?
Shall we take sandwiches to the picnic?
Good idea. I'll bring some water. We have no juice at home.

items.q: What will they take to the picnic?
items.vi: Họ mang bánh mì kẹp và nước (water); không có nước ép nên không mang.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: What time does the cooking class start?
The cooking class begins at six, doesn't it?
No, that was last week. Now it starts at half past six.

items.q: What time does the cooking class start?
items.vi: Lớp bắt đầu lúc sáu giờ rưỡi (half past six), 6 giờ là của tuần trước.

audio.t: How much is the vegetable soup?
The soup is four dollars and the salad is five dollars.
I'll have the soup and a glass of water, please.

items.q: How much is the vegetable soup?
items.vi: Súp rau giá bốn đô la, salad năm đô la.

audio.t: Where will they eat lunch?
Let's eat in the school canteen.
It's closed today. How about the cafe next to the library?
OK. The park is too cold.

items.q: Where will they eat lunch?
items.vi: Căng tin đóng cửa hôm nay nên họ đi quán cà phê cạnh thư viện.

audio.t: What does Mia need from the shop?
Mia, we need eggs, milk and flour for the cake.
We have eggs and milk. I only need flour.

items.q: What does Mia need from the shop?
items.vi: Nhà đã có trứng và sữa, chỉ cần mua bột (flour).

audio.t: When is Grandma's birthday dinner?
Is the dinner on Friday?
Friday is too busy for Dad. It's on Saturday evening.

items.q: When is Grandma's birthday dinner?
items.vi: Thứ Sáu bố bận nên bữa tối vào tối thứ Bảy.

parts.instr: Listen to Lucy and Ben talking about a cooking day. For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Nghe Lucy và Ben nói về ngày nấu ăn ở trường. Chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: Ben, are you ready for the cooking day at school on Friday?
Yes, Lucy. I'm going to make vegetable pizza with my dad.
Nice! I wanted to make pizza too, but my mother says it takes too long. We will make fruit salad.
That's easy. Which fruit will you use?
Strawberries, oranges and bananas. I don't like pineapple, so no pineapple.
Good. Do you need to bring anything from home?
Yes, a big bowl and a knife. The teacher gives us plates and spoons.
I'll bring an apron. Mine is blue, with a picture of a fish on it.
Funny! And who will eat the food?
Our parents will come at twelve o'clock. We'll all eat together in the hall.
Great. I'm a bit worried, because I never cooked at school before.
Don't worry. Mr. Brown will help us.

items.q: What will Ben make?
items.vi: Ben sẽ làm pizza rau cùng bố.

items.q: Why won't Lucy make pizza?
items.vi: Mẹ Lucy nói làm pizza mất quá nhiều thời gian.

items.q: Which fruit won't Lucy use?
items.vi: Lucy không thích dứa nên không dùng dứa.

items.q: What must Lucy bring from home?
items.vi: Lucy mang tô lớn và dao; đĩa, thìa do giáo viên đưa; tạp dề là của Ben.

items.q: When will the parents come?
items.vi: Bố mẹ đến lúc mười hai giờ.

parts.instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.instrVi: Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn đáp án đúng.

audio.t: What can students buy today?

items.text:
Last Saturday, Mia cooked dinner for her family for the first time. Her parents were at work until six, and her little brother, Toby, was at home with her. Mia wanted to make chicken soup, because her mother made it when Mia was ill. She found a recipe in an old book and went to the kitchen.
First, she cut the carrots and the onions. The onions made her eyes red! Then she put the chicken into a big pot with water. She forgot to look at the clock, and while she was reading a magazine, the water became very hot and started to go over the pot. Toby shouted, "Mia, look!" She ran back and turned the cooker off just in time.
Then she tasted the soup. It was terrible. There was too much salt. Mia felt sad, but Toby had an idea. They added some rice and potatoes, and then it was much better.
At six o'clock, her parents came home. "What a lovely smell!" said Dad. Everyone said the soup was good, and Toby said, "I helped!" Mia laughed. Next weekend, she is going to make a cake.

items.text:
Every summer, Zoe's family visits her grandfather in a small town by the sea. This year Zoe was excited because her grandfather gave her a camera for her twelfth birthday. On the first morning she walked along the beach and took many photos of boats, shells and a red kite in the sky.

In the afternoon, Zoe and her cousin Jack went to a rocky place at the end of the beach. Zoe wanted a photo of the waves, so she put her bag on a rock. When they went home, she forgot it. In the evening she looked in her room, but her bag was not there. "My camera!" she cried.

Her grandfather said, "Don't worry. We will go back early tomorrow." In the morning it was cold and foggy. They looked for an hour but found nothing. Then an old woman called Mrs. Reed waved at them from her small blue house. "Are you looking for a yellow bag?" she asked. "I found it yesterday and I wanted to bring it to you, but I didn't know your address."

Zoe was so happy that she gave Mrs. Reed her first photo of the beach. Mrs. Reed put it on her kitchen wall.

items.text:
The Little Hedgehog

Last Saturday, Nina went to her grandfather's house in the countryside. Grandpa Leo has a big garden with many trees and flowers. In the afternoon, Nina was reading a book under an apple tree when she heard a small noise. She looked under a bush and saw a tiny hedgehog. It was alone and looked hungry.

Nina ran to the kitchen and told Grandpa. "Don't touch it with your hands," he said. "Let's give it some water and a little cat food. Hedgehogs shouldn't drink milk." They put a dish of water near the bush and waited quietly.

After ten minutes, the hedgehog came out and drank all the water. Then it ate the food very fast. Nina wanted to take it home, but Grandpa shook his head. "It's a wild animal," he said. "Its home is here in the garden. Its mother is probably looking for it."

That evening, Nina watched from the window. Two big hedgehogs walked across the grass and the little one ran to them. Nina smiled. She was sad that she couldn't keep the baby, but she was happy that it was safe.

Next weekend, she is going to bring a small sign for the garden. It says: Please be careful. Hedgehogs live here!

items.vi: Nina đang đọc sách dưới gốc cây táo thì nghe thấy tiếng động nhỏ.

items.q: How did the hedgehog look?
items.vi: Bài viết nói con nhím nhỏ ở một mình và trông có vẻ đói (hungry).

items.q: What did Grandpa say about milk?
items.vi: Ông nói nhím không nên uống sữa (shouldn't drink milk).

items.vi: Ông nói nhím là động vật hoang dã, nhà của nó ở trong vườn.

items.text:
Ella was twelve, and she loved art more than sport. But every year her school had a big running race, and everyone had to take part. This year Ella was very worried because she was slow and her friends were fast.
Two weeks before the race, her neighbor, Mr. Hill, saw her walking home. 'Why do you look so sad?' he asked. Ella told him about the race. Mr. Hill used to be a running teacher. 'Let's practice together,' he said. 'Every morning at seven, before school.'
At first it was hard. Ella was tired and her legs hurt. But Mr. Hill always smiled and said, 'Slowly is OK. Just don't stop.' Day after day, she ran a little farther.
On the day of the race, the sun was hot and the track was long. Ella did not win. She finished in tenth place out of forty. But she was not tired at the end, and she was very proud. Mr. Hill was waiting with a bottle of water and a big smile. 'You didn't stop,' he said. 'That is the real prize.'

items.q: Why was Ella worried about the race?
items.vi: Ella lo lắng vì cô chạy chậm còn bạn bè thì nhanh.

items.q: Who helped Ella practice?
items.vi: Ông Hill, hàng xóm từng là giáo viên chạy bộ, đã giúp Ella tập.

items.q: When did they practice?
items.vi: Họ tập 'every morning at seven, before school', tức là trước giờ học.

items.q: What did Mr. Hill tell Ella?
items.vi: Ông nói 'Slowly is OK. Just don't stop' (chậm cũng được, đừng dừng lại).

items.q: How did Ella finish the race?
items.vi: Ella về thứ mười trong số bốn mươi người nhưng rất tự hào.

items.q:
Read the email from your friend Sam and write a reply.

To say the market opens earlier

parts.instr: Read the text about three teenagers. For each question, choose the correct person.
parts.instrVi: Đọc đoạn văn về ba thiếu niên. Mỗi câu hỏi, chọn người đúng.

items.text:
Lena: I like small shops in old streets. My favorite one sells second-hand books and comics. I go there every Saturday with my sister, and we always spend too long reading before we pay. I never buy clothes online because I want to try them on first.

Omar: I don't enjoy shopping much. I usually go to the big shopping center near my home because it has everything in one place. Last month I saved money for three weeks and bought a new tablet. I take the tram there, and it only takes eight minutes.

Kim: I love markets! My grandmother has a stall that sells vegetables, so I help her on Sundays. I carry the heavy boxes and I count the change. I get a small payment, and I use it to buy sports socks. I walk to the market because it is near my house.

items.q: Who goes shopping with a sister?
items.vi: Lena đi mua sắm với chị/em gái mỗi thứ Bảy.

items.q: Who saved money for a few weeks?
items.vi: Omar để dành tiền ba tuần để mua máy tính bảng.

items.q: Who helps a family member at work?
items.vi: Kim giúp bà bán rau ở quầy chợ.

items.q: Who goes to a place with everything in one shop?
items.vi: Omar đến trung tâm mua sắm lớn vì có mọi thứ ở một nơi.

items.q: Who wants to try on clothes before buying?
items.vi: Lena không mua quần áo trực tuyến vì muốn thử trước.

items.q: Who walks to the shops?
items.vi: Kim đi bộ đến chợ vì gần nhà.

items.q: Who travels by tram?
items.vi: Omar đi tàu điện mất tám phút.

parts.instr: Read the story and choose the correct answer for each question.
parts.instrVi: Đọc câu chuyện và chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi.

items.text:
Sara was waiting at the bus station on a cold Friday afternoon. She was going to town to buy a birthday present for her grandfather. On the bench next to her, she saw a small brown wallet. She looked inside. There was fifty dollars, a bus card and a photo of an old man with a dog. There was no name, but there was a phone number on the card.

Sara did not want to keep the wallet. She phoned the number, but nobody answered. So she took the bus to the shopping center and gave the wallet to a woman at the information desk. The woman wrote down Sara's name and said, "We will try to find the owner. Thank you!"

Sara bought a warm scarf for her grandfather and went home. That evening, her phone rang. A man said, "Hello, I think you found my wallet. My name is Mr. Park. The woman at the desk gave me your number. I was very worried." Mr. Park was the old man in the photo. The next day, he came to Sara's house with a box of chocolates. "You are a kind girl," he said. Sara smiled. It was a good weekend.

items.q: Where was Sara waiting?
items.vi: Sara đang đợi ở bến xe buýt vào chiều thứ Sáu.

items.q: Why was Sara going to town?
options: To buy a present for her grandfather
To buy a scarf for herself
items.vi: Cô bé đi mua quà sinh nhật cho ông.

items.q: What was in the wallet?
options: Fifty dollars, a bus card and a photo
Fifty dollars and a name card
A bus card and a letter
items.vi: Trong ví có 50 đô, thẻ xe buýt và một tấm ảnh.

items.q: What did Sara do with the wallet?
options: She gave it to the information desk.
She gave it to the bus driver.
items.vi: Sara đưa chiếc ví cho nhân viên quầy thông tin.

items.q: What did Mr. Park do the next day?
options: He brought chocolates to Sara's house.
items.vi: Hôm sau ông Park mang hộp sô-cô-la đến nhà Sara.

parts.instr: Write an email reply.
parts.instrVi: Viết email trả lời.

items.q:
Read the email from your friend Alex. Write an email to Alex (25 words or more).

Hi! I'm going shopping in town on Saturday to buy new shoes. Do you want to come? How can we get there? Where can we have lunch? Alex

Write about: whether you can come; how to get there; where to have lunch.
items.sample: Hi Alex, thanks for your email. Yes, I would love to come shopping with you on Saturday. Let's take the number 5 bus because it is cheap and fast. For lunch, we can eat noodles at the small cafe near the market. See you soon! Mai
items.vi: Trả lời lời mời: đồng ý đi, chọn phương tiện (xe buýt) và nơi ăn trưa; dùng câu đơn giản, đủ ba ý.

parts.instrVi: Nhìn ba bức tranh. Viết câu chuyện.

items.q: Look at the three pictures. Write the story (35 words or more).
items.sample: On Sunday, Ben took the bus to the town center. He went shopping and bought a new bag and some books. When he came out of the shop, it began to rain. He had no umbrella, so he waited for the bus and went home wet.
items.vi: Kể theo thứ tự: đi xe buýt, đi mua sắm, trời mưa; dùng thì quá khứ đơn.

items.vi: Nói phương tiện đi học và thời gian.

items.q: What is your favorite shop in your town?

items.vi: Nêu tên loại cửa hàng yêu thích và nó bán gì.

items.vi: Kể việc làm vào sáng thứ Bảy.

items.sample: I can see a supermarket. You can buy food, fruit, milk and many other things in this shop. People push a cart and put things in it. At the end, they pay money at the desk and carry their bags home.
items.vi: Mô tả siêu thị và những thứ có thể mua.

items.q: Which way of travelling in town do you like best? Why?
items.sample: I like going by bike best because it is fast and cheap. I can stop anywhere. I do not like the bus because it is crowded. But when it rains, I take the bus with my friends.
items.vi: Chọn phương tiện thích nhất và giải thích lý do.
